units.source_text: 鹤川有着一颗透明而单纯的心，

en.t: Tsurukawa had a clear and simple heart,

units.source_text: 他为我将同阔别许久的母亲相会而感到高兴，

en.t: and he was happy that I would be meeting my mother after such a long separation,

units.source_text: 寺庙的师兄弟对这件事也抱着一种好奇心。

en.t: while the senior disciples at the temple also felt a certain curiosity about it.

units.source_text: 我憎恨贫困寒碜的母亲。

en.t: I hated my poor, shabby mother.

units.source_text: 我苦于向亲切的鹤川说明自己为什么不愿同母亲会面。

en.t: I was tormented by having to explain to the kind Tsurukawa why I did not want to meet my mother.

units.source_text: 工厂下班后，鹤川就急忙挽着我的胳膊说：

en.t: After work ended at the factory, Tsurukawa hurriedly took my arm and said:
